title: MDT bits across sends: a field sent with MDT on is transmitted untouched until FRSET or ERASEAUP resets it

scenarios.summary: ENTER twice, no FRSET: NAME (typed) and NOTE (MDT set by the program) come back each time

steps.note: NAME was typed; NOTE is untouched but its MDT is on (the program sent DFHBMFSE), so the terminal transmits both
nothing typed; NAME and NOTE still have MDT on, so both are transmitted again

scenarios.summary: PF1 echoes with FRSET: the next ENTER transmits nothing, so RECEIVE MAP is MAPFAIL

steps.note: NAME was typed; NOTE is untouched but its MDT is on (the program sent DFHBMFSE), so the terminal transmits both
nothing typed and no MDT on: no field is transmitted

scenarios.summary: PF2 sends with ERASEAUP: unprotected fields are erased and their MDT reset, so the next ENTER is MAPFAIL

steps.note: NAME was typed; NOTE is untouched but its MDT is on (the program sent DFHBMFSE), so the terminal transmits both
nothing typed and no MDT on: no field is transmitted
